r.t: This is a doc showing the feats of Fang Yuan from Reverend Insanity

IF YOU ARE READING REVEREND INSANITY OR ARE INTERESTED IN READING REVEREND INSANITY AND DON’T LIKE TO BE SPOILED, THEN DON’T READ FORWARD!!! (even the disclaimer has some SPOILERS, READ WITH CAUTION!)
You have been Forewarned!
This is the rough Draft Version, will be completed at a later date!

“To be a demon is to be merciless and cruel, a murderer and destroyer. There is no place in heaven or earth for such a thing – turning into an enemy to the world, still having to face the consequences”
-chapter 1
After each book, I will provide some analysis and opinions on the volume concerning Fang Yuan’s best feat and other misc stuff.
Some information before continuing to the doc:
Because Reverend Insanity has 2334 chapters of content and because I m lazy, my writing is pretty rough as I am trying to get down as much content down

I rarely have chapter numbers for each feat because I'm too lazy to put them down. However I do have chapter markers all over indicating where the feat is roughly around. With that being said, I guarantee that all the feats I mention were in the book somewhere between the rough indicators.

I try going through every feat I can possibly find with a majority of  feats being smaller than others thus sounding like a whole bunch of yap→If I’m being honest, sometimes it can get to the point that the feat is literally irrelevant

These feats are pretty much purely observation with little to no analysis so take them with a grain of salt→that means with deeper analysis, some feats could be scaled higher and at the same time some feats could also be scaled lower than how I put it out to be

I rarely provide context to the feat so except probably me revamp of volume 1 and 2 so having some prior knowledge of the world of Reverend Insanity would be useful, however its not required, as I said I am doing this purely just for fun→ As I said before, this is just first hand observations while reading, (this includes explanations of stuff like gu, aperture, cultivation ranking system, current situations/whats going on, etc.)

I include feats where FY rely had to rely on something→what I mean is that some cognitive feats that FY had relied on outside resources such as Wisdom Gu at the disposal of FY→I guess some may argue that because Wisdom Gu is external, these feats are invalid to that I say idgaf, however what I would like to compare this to is Eddie Morra with NZT in the movie Limitless

I include abbreviations to names in Reverend Insanity, just because these names can get extremely redundant. The most common one is Fang Yuan as FY or Fang Zheng as FZ or someone like Spectral Soul Demon Venerable as SSDV. Additionally, I include where arcs start and their chapter number but not where they end, provide mini arcs and major arcs, some mini arcs can be within major arcs (these can be used as Chapter markers) →also this means that some feats don’t necessarily have to be under one arc.
I provide funny quotes or interesting quotes, peaks, and every 100 chapters with the date and time I completed them→these can be used as Chapter markers as said before

I include my own notes when reading this whether it be talking about assumption feats or indirect feats or just general comments this includes adding SCD terms such as FSIQ and FSEQ but I don’t do it for all feats as I don’t know how to categorize them
Getting into the more nitty gritty:

There are a lot of variables that I didn’t consider in these feats that could be analyzed or specified. For example, volume 3 88 true building, the amount of unknown variables involved and the extremely unlikely chance of success, mind you FY didn’t use SAC at all during this arc so he didn’t have foresight of the events leading up/a safety net , plus FY’s awful luck due to SAC being used in volume 2, plus fighting Giant Sun and Mo Yao will at the same time could be considered an extremely impressive feat (Not including the fact that he underwent immortal ascension while being attacked by multiple forces and only referencing it from the other time he did it in his previous life. (sometime within his 500 years before this moment) This could equate to multiple cats: strategy, eq, ac, multitasking, thinking/reasoning, decision making etc.(the list goes on) Of course this is just ONE example. There are likely many examples where I forget to state all the variables in a situation FY experienced which could make his predicament even more harder to pass or the fact that from volume four and onwards, FY had to pull off tactics that were against a group of higher intellectual beings then the past three volumes(aka immortals, which has been said to have way more experience/individual geniuses plus more cognitive/tactical skills(not to mention Heavenly Court) then mortals by a huge amount that could surpass “heaven and earth”. I’m speaking in narrative terms, not proven ability) Similarly, there are arguably more complex, tougher variables involved in later volumes four, five, and six due to Fang Yuan’s ever growing presence/power/reputation. On the flip side, a lot of the feats mentioned narratively could be downplayed because FY had the assistance or safety net of both Heaven Will in Volume 1-4 and Demonic Venerables in volume 5. Of course, this doesn’t mean FY was reliant on this notion and many of his feats were due to himself. The assistance was more of something that happened in the background

Another point that I haven’t talked about that much, could be that Fang Yuan has an abundance of sensory (especially Perception) feats since it's assumed that when FY is the protagonist during majority parts of the novel it's coming from his perspective. (what I’m trying to say is that during conversations or times where the author goes descriptive, it could be through the lens of FY and what he sees adding to his observation feats.)

Just as more background context: Some/most of volume 3(mainly the beginning) is going to be rough because it was the first time I considered making this doc seriously when reading Reverend Insanity. I will brush it out once the rough draft  doc has been released
I also analyze feats made by FY’s Clones as well. According to me, they are technically all a part of FY himself and his skill set.

Lastly, because this is a rough draft, towards later volumes, you would see me copying and pasting quotations/scans directly from the webnovel. I do intend to fix this up when I have more time in the future
I hope this gives more context on the document as a whole, however enjoy reading!

Lastly, I do docs for fun only as I extremely like this community and have been on the sidelines inspecting this community, watching the various edits and debates. This is my first major doc and it can DEFINITELY be improved further!! Enough with my yapping.
